summary: Full backend + frontend regression + Phase 1 (expanded audit) + Phase 2 (dynamic RBAC) verification for buildecogroup.com. Added /app/backend/tests/test_rbac.py with 15 new tests covering /api/auth/permissions, RBAC seed (24 depts, 4 system roles, buildecogroup.com company), permission guard (403 for customer, 200 for super), custom role CRUD + system-role delete guard (400), role-permission matrix GET/PUT round-trip, user assignment + escalation guard (non-super granted rbac:MANAGE still cannot assign sys_super_admin), Phase 1 audit expansion (department CREATE emits audit with module, record_id, ip_address, device, user_agent, timestamp), sensitive-key redaction (password/token/secret never leak), and legacy /api/admin/audit still readable. Total pytest: 40 passed / 40 (was 25/25 previously; +15 new). Frontend E2E: super-admin triple-click on [data-testid=login-title] opens Super Admin Panel; [data-testid=nav-admin] renders <AdminRBAC/> with all 8 tabs (companies/departments/roles/matrix/assign/modules/menus/audit); Departments tab shows 25 dept rows incl. Super Administration; Permission Matrix loads meta+grants, toggling [data-testid=cell-marketplace-VIEW] + [data-testid=matrix-save] shows 'Permissions saved' toast and persists; Users & Assignments tab exposes [data-testid=assign-role-{uid}] / [data-testid=assign-btn-{uid}]; Audit Logs tab renders 106 rows with ACTION/MODULE/USER/RECORD/IP/DEVICE/TIME columns. Regression: vendor@/customer@/contractor@buildecogroup.com log in via demo chips + Log-in button and land on Vendor Portal / Customer Dashboard / Contractor Workspace with 0 console errors and no 500s.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_rbac() re-inserts role_permissions for system roles on every startup (delete_many + insert_many). Idempotent but writes ~65 docs each restart; consider a version/hash guard.
Departments tab shows a TEST_dept_* row from backend tests — no cleanup fixture for RBAC-side test artifacts (departments/roles). Consider prefixing-based teardown similar to other TEST_ data.
server.py + rbac.py currently both call ensure_indexes/seed on startup — verify only one path runs to avoid double work (not a bug, just cost).
Permission Matrix does not warn about unsaved changes when switching roles — user can accidentally lose toggles by changing the [data-testid=matrix-role] select.
AdminRBAC.jsx (263 lines) mixes 6 sub-components in one file; could be split for maintainability.
CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True still present (carry-over).

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds RBAC (companies/departments/modules/menus/permissions/system-roles/user_roles) idempotently. Tests create TEST_-prefixed artifacts (roles, departments, users) — some remain in DB (roles are soft-disabled, departments not cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: RBAC endpoints all under /api/admin/rbac and require super_admin OR rbac:MANAGE. /api/auth/permissions is the source of truth for FE gating. Escalation guard prevents non-super users from assigning sys_super_admin even if they hold rbac:MANAGE. Audit rows now include ip_address/user_agent/device/module/record_id and redact any {password,token,secret,api_key,jwt,authorization,key,session_token,access_token,refresh_token,password_hash} value to '***REDACTED***'. Frontend Super Admin path: triple-click [data-testid=login-title] on /login -> /dashboard -> [data-testid=nav-admin] -> AdminRBAC with tabs [rbac-tab-{companies|departments|roles|matrix|assign|modules|menus|audit}]. Matrix cells are [data-testid=cell-{module}-{ACTION}], save via [data-testid=matrix-save].
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Phase 1 + Phase 2 landed additively without regressing the previously green iteration_2 baseline (25/25). All new endpoints, guards, seeds, and UI wiring behave per spec.
